verdict.rationale: Cekura documents a first-party LLM Judge metric that scores each call against natural-language criteria (cekura-docs-9, cekura-docs-42). It also offers predefined LLM-scored metrics such as Hallucination with True/False results (cekura-docs-50), auto-generated custom metrics (cekura-docs-51), and rubrics that combine metrics with thresholds and AND/OR logic (cekura-docs-32, cekura-docs-53). Missing for 10: evidence on configuring the judge model or prompt and the scoring scale, and independent hands-on corroboration of judge quality.
